shared_meaning_limits: recorded attempts/outcomes remain observations; fixed inferred block origins are not observed release locations or forecasts conditional on the recorded block
each head retains its conditional population; u needs opposing-goalie cardinality while q/r/g and all-head scoring require checked individual goalie identity
source-first entry is chain-relative, not a rookie claim; point-prior annual borrowing propagates no prior-fit uncertainty
prior_only means a current source/head-axis actor with zero applicable head likelihood; it differs from an absent ledger entry
an absent ledger entry is historical last-supported state outside the current head axis, not a current estimate or a claim that the actor did not play
setter candidate mixtures are inferred from declared source context, not observations of passes
selected feature families, active encoded columns and available/unavailable/structurally absent support describe distinct construction facts; none establishes predictive validation
overlapping exclusion reasons and shared missingness columns are not additive disjoint populations
in-sample means, reliability and weighted origin-imputed losses do not establish held-out or unconditional all-attempt forecast calibration
g auxiliary setter-mixture likelihood includes supported credit evidence; its outcome-only diagnostic remains separately named
native ftol completion and a bounded probability-stability comparison do not certify raw gtol, a global optimum or general accuracy
selector population eligibility and withheld individual-goalie contexts are distinct from uncovered selector requirements; zero uncovered does not mean every source context supports all-head scoring
probe variants remain separately tagged; no tightened coefficient promotion or probe predecessor is implied
reported coaching identities are source reports, not attendance or coaching-quality evidence
experimental estimates are not observed facts, causal isolation, calibrated ability claims or scientific admission
